tickets.title: Create the first usable LINE array
tickets.delivers: A modeler can activate Array with pre-picked sources or select them afterward, enter a simple count/pitch LINE, create ordinary copies, and undo/redo or cancel the operation. The tool and native scene operation work together; this is not a shell-only or math-only ticket.
tickets.published_title: [Array 01] Create the first usable LINE array

tickets.title: Validate LINE count and spacing inputs
tickets.delivers: A modeler receives a specific validation result for zero/single counts, invalid intervals, and requests beyond the configured output limit before geometry is allocated.
tickets.published_title: [Array 02] Validate LINE count and spacing inputs

tickets.title: Place LINE arrays by extent or fitted count
tickets.delivers: A modeler can choose fixed intervals within an extent or fit a generated count to an overall LINE length, with the expected endpoint/remainder behavior.
tickets.published_title: [Array 03] Place LINE arrays by extent or fitted count

tickets.title: Define LINE graphically with anchors and assemblies
tickets.delivers: A modeler can define a LINE graphically in its own frame, choose a source anchor, replace sources, repeat a multi-object assembly, and request the declared simple clear-gap behavior through the same working tool.
tickets.published_title: [Array 04] Define LINE graphically with anchors and assemblies

tickets.title: Preserve native source geometry in LINE arrays
tickets.delivers: A modeler can choose smooth-solid, straight/curved NURBS, NURBS-surface, NURBS-faced-solid, and controlled-solid sources in the existing LINE workflow, with each type tested separately and preserved natively.
tickets.published_title: [Array 05] Preserve native source geometry in LINE arrays

tickets.title: Validate controlled-object LINE transforms
tickets.delivers: A modeler can rotate and scale supported controlled sources while retaining their parameters, and receives a specific rejection for verified unsupported nonuniform transformations before controls are lost.
tickets.published_title: [Array 06] Validate controlled-object LINE transforms

tickets.title: Choose independent or verified linked LINE output
tickets.delivers: A modeler can select independent copies or the verified native linked mechanism; source geometry edits propagate only for the chosen linked behavior.
tickets.published_title: [Array 07] Choose independent or verified linked LINE output

tickets.title: Add seeded LINE position variation
tickets.delivers: A modeler can set a seed and position variation in units or a defined percentage through LINE Tool Options and obtain repeatable native scene placements.
tickets.published_title: [Array 08] Add seeded LINE position variation

tickets.title: Add LINE size variation
tickets.delivers: A modeler can vary LINE repetition size uniformly or independently by axis on supported sources using explicit percentage or numeric ranges.
tickets.published_title: [Array 09] Add LINE size variation

tickets.title: Add LINE rotation variation
tickets.delivers: A modeler can vary LINE repetition rotation using degrees or a percentage of an explicit reference angle, and observe the intended native orientation changes.
tickets.published_title: [Array 10] Add LINE rotation variation

tickets.title: Add LINE interval and clear-gap variation
tickets.delivers: A modeler can randomize nominal LINE intervals or the supported clear-gap rule separately from position jitter, with explicit numeric or percentage bounds.
tickets.published_title: [Array 11] Add LINE interval and clear-gap variation

tickets.title: Make LINE variation stable under edits
tickets.delivers: A modeler can disable variation to recover the deterministic layout, preserve intervals within an extent, change one channel independently, and increase LINE count without rerolling existing placements.
tickets.published_title: [Array 12] Make LINE variation stable under edits

tickets.title: Compose LINE variation in an explicit frame
tickets.delivers: A modeler can use a declared randomization frame and combine supported size/rotation/position variation predictably; clear gaps follow varied sizes under the supported rule and invalid scale ranges are rejected.
tickets.published_title: [Array 13] Compose LINE variation in an explicit frame

tickets.title: Preserve native geometry under LINE variation
tickets.delivers: A modeler can apply the supported random transforms to controlled, smooth-solid, NURBS-curve, and NURBS-surface LINE sources, with separate runtime evidence that representations and supported controls survive.
tickets.published_title: [Array 14] Preserve native geometry under LINE variation

tickets.title: Complete LINE preview and operation history
tickets.delivers: A modeler can revise a LINE preview without accumulating output, handle a deleted source, cancel temporary geometry, and Apply the complete array as one undoable/redoable operation.
tickets.published_title: [Array 15] Complete LINE preview and operation history

tickets.title: Accept the durable LINE_READY baseline
tickets.delivers: A modeler can save and reopen committed LINE output with its native geometry and existing material assignments. The accumulated LINE workflow passes before another layout is developed.
tickets.published_title: [Array 16] Accept the durable LINE_READY baseline

tickets.title: Add Rectangle using the shared LINE workflow
tickets.delivers: A modeler can create a two-axis Rectangle grid, enter its extents, and switch between LINE and Rectangle while retaining applicable shared settings and each layout's own values.
tickets.published_title: [Array 17] Add Rectangle using the shared LINE workflow

tickets.title: Extend Rectangle to a 3D Grid
tickets.delivers: A modeler can add a third grid axis with independent pitch or extent while reusing accepted source selection, output, variation, and lifecycle behavior.
tickets.published_title: [Array 18] Extend Rectangle to a 3D Grid

tickets.title: Add Radial placement and angular variation
tickets.delivers: A modeler can create full-circle or arc arrays with numeric/graphic input, angular spacing, radial orientation, and seeded angular interval variation through the shared tool.
tickets.published_title: [Array 19] Add Radial placement and angular variation

tickets.title: Assign Path Sources and Targets explicitly
tickets.delivers: A modeler can retain Sources while assigning a compatible guide, resolve ambiguous mixed preselection, reject invalid targets with a reason, and replace a source without losing target identities. This is verifiable selection behavior in the active tool.
tickets.published_title: [Array 20] Assign Path Sources and Targets explicitly

tickets.title: Place on straight and polyline path fixtures
tickets.delivers: A modeler can select a straight line/edge, polygonal polyline, or geometrically straight NURBS guide and generate native placements at verified physical-distance stations for each distinct guide type.
tickets.published_title: [Array 21] Place on straight and polyline path fixtures

tickets.title: Place along a curved NURBS path
tickets.delivers: A modeler can choose a curved NURBS guide and obtain physical-distance placement verified independently of curve parameter spacing.
tickets.published_title: [Array 22] Place along a curved NURBS path

tickets.title: Place along an arc guide
tickets.delivers: A modeler can choose a native arc guide and obtain placements matching a known analytic arc fixture.
tickets.published_title: [Array 23] Place along an arc guide

tickets.title: Place along a native curve or spline guide
tickets.delivers: A modeler can choose a recorded native curve/spline object and obtain native scene placement verified against its physical length; unsupported object types are not silently facetted.
tickets.published_title: [Array 24] Place along a native curve or spline guide

tickets.title: Control path intervals margins and closure
tickets.delivers: A modeler can use physical path intervals, start/end margins, and a closed-path distribution without a duplicate seam placement.
tickets.published_title: [Array 25] Control path intervals margins and closure

tickets.title: Orient repetitions along supported paths
tickets.delivers: A modeler can choose tangent alignment, roll, and supported upright/nonplanar frame behavior, with independently checked orientation fixtures.
tickets.published_title: [Array 26] Orient repetitions along supported paths

tickets.title: Revalidate active Path targets and preview
tickets.delivers: A modeler receives a clear response when switching to an incompatible layout or deleting an active path target; targets are not silently reassigned and stale preview output is invalidated.
tickets.published_title: [Array 27] Revalidate active Path targets and preview

tickets.title: Distribute along polygon perimeters or edges
tickets.delivers: A modeler can choose whole-perimeter or per-edge placement, selected edges, shared-corner deduplication, and explicit outgoing-edge corner orientation through the shared Array workflow.
tickets.published_title: [Array 28] Distribute along polygon perimeters or edges

tickets.title: Use native NURBS boundary edges as guides
tickets.delivers: A modeler can select straight and curved NURBS surface/object boundary edges as guides, with separate distance/representation evidence rather than display-facet placement.
tickets.published_title: [Array 29] Use native NURBS boundary edges as guides

tickets.title: Use native solid edges as guides
tickets.delivers: A modeler can select straight and curved solid boundary edges as guides, while preserving native edge evaluation and the source representation.
tickets.published_title: [Array 30] Use native solid edges as guides

tickets.title: Create one repetition per target vertex
tickets.delivers: A modeler can pre-pick target vertices before choosing a source or explicitly designate an object's All Vertices scope and obtain one repetition per selected topological vertex.
tickets.published_title: [Array 31] Create one repetition per target vertex

tickets.title: Preserve vertex identity and topology semantics
tickets.delivers: A modeler gets one output per unique topological identity: repeated references are deduplicated, distinct coincident vertices remain distinct, and display refinement does not change the count.
tickets.published_title: [Array 32] Preserve vertex identity and topology semantics

tickets.title: Finish seeded Vertex variation and options
tickets.delivers: A modeler can add a vertex target without rerolling existing identities and apply optional position variation while retaining one-per-vertex output; Vertex options omit inapplicable gap/count controls.
tickets.published_title: [Array 33] Finish seeded Vertex variation and options
